test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 3 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, “IS” is coded as “169”, and “AM” is coded as “11”. How will “IN” be coded in that language?
solution:
Table of English alphabet positional value

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1adbbf1a08ab8fe30ff354bb829a01906748dbf4a1b177c6387f258a30303dfd.png] 

According to given coding language

IS [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1516f2d58864252d2855ef00de847a3b136e9f17ee18328346289d25acd1ce14.png] 9 × 19 = 171 - 2 = 169

AM [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1516f2d58864252d2855ef00de847a3b136e9f17ee18328346289d25acd1ce14.png] 1 × 13 = 13 - 2 = 11 

Similarly, 

**IN [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1516f2d58864252d2855ef00de847a3b136e9f17ee18328346289d25acd1ce14.png] 9 × 14 = 126 - 2 = 124**

Hence, **124** is the** correct answer.**
